rules.content:
/*
la piovra ransomware
*/

rule la_piovra_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.lapiovra"
        description = "Detects la piovra ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "la_piovra" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "LA_PIOVRA" ascii
        $onion  = "lapiovra.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
